pages.title: Schichtplan (with event filter: "Schichtplan · <Event>")
pages.purpose: Plan shifts on a calendar (week/day/month/agenda/per person), see coverage, assign people, approve applications and check people in/out.
pages.permission: shifts.view (without it but with shifts.self → redirect /shifts/me)
pages.size: list (default Page size; area layout max-w-6xl)

header.meta: "{filled} von {needed} Plätzen besetzt" (shifts.coverage) for the focused week, or the whole event when ?event is set

urlState.meaning: calendar view: week (default) | day | month | agenda | resource (per person); agenda is the default when ?event is set
focused day (YYYY-MM-DD); loads shifts 6 weeks before to 7 weeks after
FilterMenu: only shifts of this event (all of them, no date window)
FilterMenu: only shifts at this location
prefill from an empty-slot click or drag in the calendar; resource = person column → that person is assigned on create

fields.name: event
fields.label: Event
fields.notes: all label 'Ganze Woche (alle)' (shifts.allWeek); only events from the last 30 days on, max 100; hidden when there are none

fields.name: location
fields.label: Ort
fields.notes: all label 'Alle Orte'; hidden without locations

sections.title: Kalender
sections.notes: CalendarView views week/day/month/agenda/resource. Entry title '<Position or Bezeichnung> · <assigned>/<needed> · <names>'. Colour: full = chart-1, partly = chart-4, empty = destructive. Click → ?shift=<id>. Empty slot click/drag → ?new=shift&start&end (shifts.manage). Drag & drop moves a shift (moveShift, shifts.manage). Resource view: one column per active staff person, read-only entries.

actions.label: (drag entry)
actions.result: times changed; error shown as toast

overlays.title: Neue Schicht | <Position or Bezeichnung>

actions.label: Speichern | Neue Schicht
actions.result: back to calendar, toast 'Gespeichert.'; with ?resource the person is assigned too ('Wird {name} zugeteilt.' hint)

actions.label: Person einteilen
actions.notes: NativeSelect of all active staff not yet on the shift; '(nicht eingetragen für diese Position)' suffix

actions.label: Einchecken / Auschecken
actions.notes: writes a time entry for the person

overlays.notes: Section 'Besetzung {count} / {needed}' (shifts.people) lists assignments with check-in/out times. Without shifts.manage the sheet shows only the assignment list (read-only).

pages.phone: Primary as round + by the tab bar; CalendarView (ReUI) on phones; sheet full width.
uxNotes: 'Schicht löschen' is a ghost SubmitButton at the bottom of the sheet with no data-confirm and not a red ⋯ item (docs/design/app.md: delete = destructive ⋯ item with confirm).
Removing a person from a shift has no confirm.
Record param is ?shift=<id>, not the documented ?edit=<id>.
Shift sheet mixes the edit form (SaveBar) and immediate-action forms (assign, check in, remove) below it: two save paths in one sheet; assignment actions submit while form edits may be unsaved.
Event filter label 'Ganze Woche (alle)' while it actually means 'no event filter' and the view may be month/agenda.
Event, position, location and staff are NativeSelects; event list capped at 100 (no server-search picker).
Coverage meta always reflects the focused week, even in month or agenda view.

pages.title: Meine Schichten
pages.purpose: A team member clocks in/out (optionally on a project), adds/edits own time entries, applies for open shifts and checks in/out of own shifts.

urlState.meaning: YYYY-MM for the time entry list (MonthNav)
<entry id> = edit sheet (only while not approved)

sections.title: Zeiterfassung

fields.name: project_id
fields.label: Projekt
fields.notes: only when not clocked in and projects module on + projects.view/manage; 'Kein Projekt'; open projects, max 300

sections.notes: Box with Einstempeln/Ausstempeln, hint 'Ohne Schicht einstempeln…' or 'Eingestempelt seit {time}', ghost '+ Zeit nachtragen' link; MonthNav (‹ Monat ›) next to the heading; line 'Arbeitszeit diesen Monat: {hours}'.

sections.title: Zeiteinträge
sections.notes: TimeEntryList; Tag links to ?edit=<id> unless approved.

sections.title: Meine Schichten
sections.notes: ShiftSelfView: line 'Diesen Monat gearbeitet: {hours} h · Soll: {hours} h'; list of own upcoming shifts with status badge (beworben/eingeteilt/Ausgecheckt.) and buttons Zurückziehen / Einchecken (from 2 h before start) / Auschecken. Empty: 'Gerade keine Schichten.'

sections.title: Offene Schichten
sections.notes: Open shifts in the next 45 days the person is qualified for, '{count} Plätze frei', button 'Bewerben'. Empty: 'Keine offenen Schichten.'

actions.label: Bewerben
actions.result: toast 'Beworben – du wirst benachrichtigt, wenn du eingeteilt bist.'

pages.empty: Not in team: EmptyState 'Du bist noch nicht im Team dieses Schichtplans.' (no action). Entry list: 'Keine Zeiteinträge in diesem Monat.'
pages.phone: Primary 'Zeit nachtragen' as round + (clock in/out stays in the page box, not in the thumb zone).
uxNotes: Time entry sheet uses a plain SubmitButton 'Speichern' instead of <SaveBar> (all other shift sheets use SaveBar).
'Eintrag löschen' is an outline button without confirm.
'Zeit nachtragen' appears twice (header primary and ghost button inside the clock box).
Two month totals on one page: 'Arbeitszeit diesen Monat' follows ?month, while 'Diesen Monat gearbeitet' in ShiftSelfView is always the current month (UTC month start).
Two clock concepts with similar wording: 'Einstempeln/Ausstempeln' (free time) vs 'Einchecken/Auschecken' (shift).
Project picker is a NativeSelect of up to 300 projects (code comment: ponytail, search picker if it grows).
Empty state for people not in the team has no action or link (dead end); adding someone happens in /shifts/team by a manager.

pages.title: Stunden
pages.purpose: Monthly time account per person: shifts, planned, worked, target, balance, approval status and law warnings; export for payroll.

actions.label: ‹ <Monat Jahr> ›
actions.notes: MonthNav (prev/next month links, aria 'Vorheriger Monat' / 'Nächster Monat')

sections.title: Stunden
sections.notes: Hint shifts.hoursHint + '{count} Einträge sind noch nicht freigegeben und fehlen im Export.' Only active staff or staff with shifts/entries this month.

uxNotes: Month navigation sits in the header actions (top bar) although docs/design/app.md puts views/filters in the list toolbar, never the top bar.
No approve action on the list; approval only on the person page.

pages.title: <Person name>
pages.purpose: One person's month of time entries with warnings; managers correct/add entries, approvers approve or reopen the month.
pages.permission: shifts.view (edit: shifts.manage or shifts.approve; approve: shifts.approve; delete entry: shifts.manage)

urlState.meaning: time = add entry for this person

sections.title: Summary
sections.notes: 'Arbeitszeit diesen Monat: {hours} · Soll: {hours} h' + buttons on the right

actions.label: {count} Einträge freigeben
actions.result: toast 'Monat freigegeben.'; person can no longer edit those entries

overlays.title: Zeit nachtragen | Zeiteintrag bearbeiten
overlays.notes: Approved entries stay editable here for managers (no project picker on this page).

uxNotes: Approving a whole month has no confirm.
Entry form here has no project picker (unlike /shifts/me), so a manager can't set/correct the project of an entry.
Action buttons placed in a page row, not in the header (other record pages use header actions).

pages.title: Team
pages.purpose: Which org members are on the shift team, with employment type, target hours and the positions they can do.

fields.name: user
fields.label: Mitglied
fields.notes: create only; org members not yet on the team; hint shifts.memberHint (invite people first under Einstellungen → Mitglieder)

actions.label: Speichern | Neue Person
actions.result: back to /shifts/team, toast 'Gespeichert.'; duplicate → 'Dieses Mitglied ist schon im Team.'

uxNotes: No way to remove a person from the team, only 'Aktiv' off.
'Art' (shifts.roleLabel) vs 'Beschäftigung' (time.roleLabel) vs HR employment type: three names for the employment kind.
Name/e-mail come from the profile and can't be edited here; staff ↔ HR employee link lives in HR (staff_id), not visible here.

pages.title: Einstellungen
pages.purpose: Define positions (stations with usual headcount) and recurring shift series that generate shifts 8 weeks ahead.

sections.title: Positionen
sections.notes: Inline rows, one form each + empty last row to add. Without locations: hint 'Orte … legst du in den Einstellungen an.' + link 'Orte verwalten' → /settings/locations.

sections.title: Wiederkehrende Schichten
sections.notes: Card action '+ Neue wiederkehrende Schicht'; row → ?series=<id>. Empty 'Noch keine wiederkehrenden Schichten.'

actions.label: Speichern | Neue wiederkehrende Schicht
actions.result: regenerates future shifts; toast 'Gespeichert, {count} Schichten angelegt.'

uxNotes: 'Serie und zukünftige Schichten löschen' deletes many shifts with no confirm, as a ghost button.
Position delete (trash icon) has no confirm.
Series uses ?series=<id> instead of ?edit=<id>.
Start/end time use native <input type=time> (browser locale: may show AM/PM), against the DateInput rule.
Saving a series silently re-creates future shifts (only a small hint text).
Weekday and fixed-people pickers are long checkbox lists rather than chips/segments.
